CHANGE ORDER

Change Order Number: 07
Project: Larkfield Commons, Building C
Project Number: 2025-0418
Owner: Ellery Development Partners, LLC
Contractor: Bramble Construction Group, Inc.
Architect: Sowande Adeyemi Architects, PC
Contract dated: June 3, 2025
Date of this Change Order: April 17, 2026

THE CONTRACT IS CHANGED AS FOLLOWS

1. Substitute Type A2 acoustic ceiling tile for the Type A1 tile specified in Section 09 51 00, at the Owner's direction, per Architect's Supplemental Instruction 14 dated March 30, 2026. Add $0.00; this is a no-cost substitution.

2. Add underslab vapor barrier at Grid Lines 4 through 9, not shown on the drawings and not reasonably inferable, per RFI 88 and the Architect's response dated April 2, 2026. Add $46,820.00.

3. Delete the exterior bicycle shelter at the north elevation in its entirety, per the Owner's letter of April 9, 2026. Deduct $23,150.00.

4. Add eleven (11) calendar days to the Contract Time for the underslab vapor barrier work, which is on the critical path per the March 2026 schedule update.

ADJUSTMENT OF CONTRACT SUM

The original Contract Sum was $14,880,000.00.
The net change by previously authorized Change Orders 01 through 06 was an increase of $312,455.00.
The Contract Sum prior to this Change Order was $15,192,455.00.
The Contract Sum will be increased by this Change Order in the amount of $23,670.00.
The new Contract Sum including this Change Order will be $15,216,125.00.

ADJUSTMENT OF CONTRACT TIME

The Contract Time prior to this Change Order was 640 calendar days.
The Contract Time will be increased by eleven (11) calendar days.
The date of Substantial Completion as of this Change Order is therefore May 14, 2027.

ACCORD AND SATISFACTION

The Contractor agrees that the adjustments stated above are full and complete compensation, including all direct and indirect costs, overhead, profit, and delay and impact costs, for the changes described. The Contractor waives any claim for additional time or money arising out of or related to the work described in this Change Order, whether known or unknown as of the date signed.

This Change Order does not alter any other term of the Contract. Except as expressly modified here, all terms of the Contract dated June 3, 2025 remain in full force and effect.
